reviews.reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (AI; batch record requested by the maintainer on 2026-10-21)
reviews.method: Mechanical screen with aws-design-review review-queue: the ap-northeast-3 type schema is byte-identical (canonical JSON SHA-256) to the ap-northeast-1 snapshot the ledger was reviewed against, and none of the type's registered rules, references, typed Python checks or open questions mention regions, availability zones, Local Zones, Wavelength, Outposts, partitions or region codes.
reviews.rationale: The carried rules and references test property values of one template resource; with an identical type schema their conditions do not depend on the region. The type's presence in the official ap-northeast-3 schema shows CloudFormation support there. Feature, quota and instance-type availability per region stay outside the rules, as before; types with any regional wording, or with a different schema, keep the regional question for a person.
